decisionsTitle: «Cere reconfirmarea»: «Vin» on the organizers' message, a ready reminder text, and a queue where a staff send steps aside
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11**, on the reminder before the race, as relayed to this branch: a reminder with a ready text that asks who is coming, and a send of two hundred that never holds up a runner's own emails. His last sentence, which every screen and every text of this change keeps true, in four parts:

1. the club sees who pressed «Vin»;
2. answering is optional — nothing in a state, a place, a deadline, the allocator or the capacity formula reads the answer;
3. «N-au răspuns» is information for the organizers, not a state;
4. nobody is cancelled automatically: the composer's help line says so, and the ready text says that pressing nothing leaves the registration exactly as it is.

**The two choices this builds.** «Vin» goes on the organizers' own message, «Trimite un mesaj participanților», behind a tick of the send — not on the automatic reminder; and the ready text is a button that fills the boxes, which the organizer may still change before sending.

### Part one: «Cere reconfirmarea», «Vin» and the ready text

**The tick.** The composer gets «Cere reconfirmarea» under the message, its help line «Emailul primește și butonul „Vin”. Nu se anulează nimeni automat; „N-au răspuns” e doar o informație pentru organizatori.» A send with it carries `askReconfirm: true` in every outbox row's payload, beside the words, and in its audit row (`askReconfirm`, `asked`, `askedTest`). The preview draws both buttons — «Vin» and «Nu mai pot ajunge» — on an inert example link (`${APP_BASE_URL}/<locale>/EXAMPLE#…`), as every `/admin/emails` preview does: no token is minted.

**The button.** «Vin» / "I'm coming" is a filled, full-width button in the club's ink blue just above «Nu mai pot ajunge», at least 48 pixels tall, its glyph the manage page's `EventAvailable` in white (`public/brand/email-reconfirm.png`, from `yarn brand:assets`), and one sentence under it: «Ne spui că vii. Nu e obligatoriu.» It uses the manage link the cancel already carries — the same `MANAGE_REGISTRATION` token minted at send time, at `#reconfirm` instead of `#cancel`: no new token purpose, no enum value. It goes only where «Nu mai pot ajunge» goes (the registration's own address, active, the event ahead and running) and only to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration (`RECONFIRM_STATUSES`); never on a club copy (§320). A waiting-list offer gets no «Vin»: its own email asks for the declaration.

**The page.** The manage page draws, for a registration a send asked while the event is ahead, «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» — not «Da, vin», which is the RSVP feature's word (§811) — the line «Răspunsul e opțional: dacă nu apeși nimic, înscrierea rămâne exact cum e.» and the way out, «Nu mai poți ajunge? Folosește „Anulează înscrierea” mai jos.»; a pending declaration and a waiting entry each get one more sentence, an offer the sentence that points at its email. The GET writes nothing (BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4). The POST reads the manage token through `readActionTokenContext` — the reader «Schimbă adresa» binds to the registration's current participant, so a link sent to an address the registration has left is answered as a missing token and records nothing — and never spends it: the same page still cancels. Per person (§547): a family member of the same address at the same event is accepted, a stranger refused. One transaction locks the registration, checks its state and its event, and answers every open ask of it — the answer is about the event, not one email — once: a second press writes nothing and makes no audit row, the first moment is kept («set, not flip»). A cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a registration nobody asked is answered «Răspunsul nu a fost înregistrat…» with nothing written. The audit row is `registration.reconfirmed`, no staff actor, `{ via: "MANAGE_LINK", sends }`, never a name.

**What is recorded.** One table, `registration_reconfirmations` — one row per registration asked per send (`registration_id`, `event_id`, `send_id`, `asked_at`, `reconfirmed_at`), unique per registration and send, cascading with the registration and with the event; migration `0200_registration_reconfirmations`, expand only, nothing backfilled. Written inside the send's own transaction, test registrations too (AGENTS.md §12.6). A table and not columns on `registrations`, because a second send's ask would overwrite the first's numbers; not derived from the outbox, because its sent rows are swept. «Schimbă adresa» re-addresses a waiting message with its payload, so the flag travels with the row; the asks belong to the registration and stay with it.

**What staff see.** The chip «A reconfirmat» (`StatusChip glyph="reconfirmed"`) on a list row whose person said «Vin» and is still registered; the filter «Reconfirmare» — «Au reconfirmat · Au anulat după cerere · N-au răspuns» — one `EXISTS` in the list's one `WHERE`, so its count, its pages, its summary and its export follow it; on each «Mesaje trimise» row of a send that asked, «Au reconfirmat {yes} · Au anulat {cancelled} · N-au răspuns {none}», one grouped query for the whole history, test registrations left out; one line on the registration's page, «A spus că vine {date}.»; the export column «Reconfirmat» after «Partener», «Note interne» still the last; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists each ask and its answer. Per ask, the first that matches wins: cancelled at or after the ask; said «Vin» and still registered; still registered and silent. An expired registration is in none of the three. A structural guard (`tests/unit/registrations/reconfirmation-never-leaves.test.ts`) keeps the answer off every public page but the person's own manage page, out of the email's renderer (which reads only the flag and the link), the desk, the sponsors' file, the allocator, the capacity formula and the maintenance job.

**The ready text.** «Completează cu textul de reminder», above the subject, writes the four boxes from the catalogues — Romanian into the Romanian boxes and English into the English ones, whatever the backoffice's language, the placeholders literal — and ticks «Cere reconfirmarea»; it asks «Înlocuiești textul scris?» first when a box already holds words. The text: «Ne vedem la {eventTitle}? Spune-ne dacă vii» / "See you at {eventTitle}? Tell us if you're coming", then six paragraphs — the greeting, when and where, «Dacă vii, apasă „Vin” mai jos. Așa știm pe cine așteptăm.», «Dacă nu mai poți ajunge, apasă „Nu mai pot ajunge”, ca locul să poată fi dat cuiva de pe lista de așteptare.», **«Dacă nu apeși nimic, înscrierea ta rămâne exact cum e.»** and the thanks. Every placeholder is one the subject can fill.

### Part two: the queue's order, and what the Administrator is told about a send

**Three tiers.** The outbox claims a registration's own messages first, then the staff sends to many (`BULK_CLUB_COPY_MESSAGES`: «Trimite un mesaj participanților», «Detalii actualizate» — each send's club copy is the same type, so it rides with its send), then the bulk ones (§445): three claims, each oldest first, because an `ORDER BY CASE` alone would give the order but not a tier's cap. A verification queued after a burst of two hundred leaves in the next batch, and the burst still drains completely.

**The reserve.** A staff send keeps `max(10, 10%)` of a daily allowance for the registrations' own emails (10% of a monthly one, none without a ceiling): `readStaffLimit` beside `readBulkLimit`, the same «anything due?» query and the same counts. What does not fit waits on Mailgun's road for the reset, its attempt untouched, marked `STAFF_RESERVE_HELD_ERROR`; `/api/health` reads that mark as the reserve working, as it reads the newsletter's hold — neither deferred nor a provider's error — and once its turn has passed by the overdue allowance it is late like any row. The trade-off: a stalled staff send shows on its «Mesaje trimise» row and on `/admin/emails`, not on `/api/health`. «Trimite acum» (§540) is not held to it — it asked the allowance for exactly its rows — and the batch size, the pinger, the hourly pace, `BULK_RESERVE_SHARE` and the offers' immediate drain are unchanged.

**Before «Trimite».** The question names, worded on the server, how long the send takes and whether it fits: «Pleacă treptat, câte 20 la 15 minute ziua (noaptea mai rar): cam {hours} ore pe ritmul de zi.» — or «cel mult {hourly} pe oră» when Mailgun's hour is the slower — then «Încape în cota de azi.» or the deferral line that says how many go today and how many after midnight UTC. The hours count the queue ahead of the send (everything waiting but the bulk mail, which goes after it), at one batch a run. The composer's headroom is the plan's remainder less the reserve and less what waits ahead. No start time is promised: «Când pleacă emailurile» says when the first leaves.

**Progress.** Each «Mesaje trimise» row shows «Au plecat {left} · Așteaptă {waiting}» (and «Nu au plecat {failed}» when some failed), one grouped query over the outbox by send, test registrations left out; hidden once the retention job has swept the sent rows.

### Decided for the owner (the defaults; each can change)

1. **The staff sends' reserve:** `max(10, 10%)` of the day's allowance. The alternative, no reserve, is marginally faster but lets a verification wait until after midnight UTC behind a send.
2. **The Mailgun plan for the race week: no code change.** On Mailgun Free (100 a day), a send of 200 and the club's copy — 201 messages — leaves over three days with the reserve (90 a day) and three without (100 a day); at 20 every 15 minutes the day's 90 leave in a little over an hour. To send it in one day the owner can raise the plan for the race month on «Setări» → «Emailuri» (Basic: 10 000 a month; 201 messages then take about three hours at 20 every 15 minutes, or longer at a lower hourly pace), or route «Anunțuri» through the club's Gmail there (its own daily cap; no Mailgun allowance spent).
3. **«Au anulat după cerere»** counts any cancellation at or after the ask — the participant's or an Administrator's. The alternative was the participant's own only.

### For the lawyer

The privacy notice already covers the organizers' messages (art. 6(1)(b)) and keeps registration data for the registration's life; no legal text or template is changed here. Two sentences for the next review:

1. «Clubul păstrează, la o înscriere, dacă și când participantul a apăsat „Vin” într-un mesaj al organizatorilor; nu schimbă înscrierea și se șterge odată cu ea.»
2. «Nota nu numește încă acest răspuns; o versiune viitoare îl poate numi explicit.»

### Refused in version one

- **An automatic cancel of those who do not answer.** Answering is optional; a missed email must never cost a place.
- **An automatic second reminder.** The club sends another by hand; a job would be a new automatic email.
- **Changing `EVENT_REMINDER`.** It goes to every confirmed registration on its schedule (AGENTS.md §16.3); asking there would ask everybody, every time.
- **Anything on a public page.** Who said «Vin» is the organizers' information, not a disclosure (§10.10).
- **A deadline to answer, or a state for the silent.** «N-au răspuns» is a count, never a status the allocator could read.
changelogLine: - **«Cere reconfirmarea» and «Vin»** — a tick on «Trimite un mesaj participanților» puts «Vin» beside «Nu mai pot ajunge» in every email of the send; the person's «Da, vin la cursă» on their own page is recorded once, optional and changing nothing, and staff see «A reconfirmat», a three-way filter, the counts on «Mesaje trimise» and a «Reconfirmat» column; «Completează cu textul de reminder» fills both languages; a send to many now waits behind the registrations' own emails, keeps ten a day for them, and says before «Trimite» how long it takes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an organizer's message sent with «Cere reconfirmarea» to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration of an event still ahead, when the person opens «Vin» then the manage page's GET asks «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» and writes nothing; the POST reads the manage token through the reader bound to the registration's current participant, never spends it, records the first moment once (a second press writes nothing and audits nothing) and changes no state, place, hold or deadline; a waiting-list offer, a cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a link of an address the registration has left records nothing (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given due rows of every kind, when the outbox claims a batch then it takes a registration's own messages first, the staff sends to many (`BULK_CLUB_COPY_MESSAGES`, their club copy with them) second within the allowance less `max(10, 10%)` of a daily one, and the bulk ones last; a verification queued after a burst of 200 is claimed before the burst's remaining rows, the burst still drains completely, the staff rows held for the reserve wait for the reset with no attempt spent and `/api/health` stays ok, and «Trimite acum» is not held to the reserve (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Cere reconfirmarea», when a send or its preview is asked then only a role that may message the participants (the Organizer and above) is served and every other role is refused FORBIDDEN with no ask written; who said «Vin» is read only by the backoffice's list, the registration's page, «Mesaje trimise», the registrations' Excel and CSV and «Toate datele unei persoane», and by no public page, email, desk, sponsors' file, allocator or capacity term (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Cere reconfirmarea» with «Vin» and a ready reminder text; a staff send to many steps aside for the registrations' own emails
